bootstrap-sass gem backdoor enabled RCE.

Repository: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap-sass
Date: 2019-03-26

Impact Type: Backdoor/Remote Code Execution

Synopsis

A popular Ruby gem, bootstrap-sass, had a malicious version (3.2.0.3) published on RubyGems.org after a likely maintainer account compromise. The backdoor allowed remote command execution on Rails applications in production environments.
